name: ANOTHER TAKE: A LONG WAY
source:
Another Take is a big studio known for their work on animation!
Enjoy a sneak peak from behind the scenes of their largest show ever made, "A Long Way".

[Translated from [url=https://alej-io.itch.io/another-take]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「Another Take」是一家以動畫製作聞名的大型工作室！
快來一睹他們有史以來規模最大的節目《A Long Way》的幕後花絮吧。

[譯自[url=https://alej-io.itch.io/another-take]itch.io[/url]]
